findings.name: MobileNotificationCenter route registration
findings.finding: MobileNotificationCenter.jsx (516 lines) exists but is not registered in routes/index.jsx. No navigation path reaches this page.
findings.impact: Mobile users cannot view or manage notifications. Notification badge is visible but non-functional.
findings.recommendation: Add route in routes/index.jsx and link from MobileBottomNav or More menu.

findings.name: Event-driven workflow enrollment triggers
findings.finding: 13 trigger call sites across lead/loan update endpoints call trigger_workflow_evaluation_for_lead/loan().

findings.name: Scheduler polling fallback active
findings.finding: WorkflowScheduler polling at 5-minute intervals continues as fallback for missed event triggers.

findings.name: Lead stage mapping coverage
findings.finding: 10 lead stages mapped to workflows, 7 intentionally skipped. Full coverage.

findings.name: Loan stage mapping coverage
findings.finding: 13 loan stages mapped to workflows (under_contract, last_mile, post_close), 7 intentionally skipped. Includes WF-010 additions: UW_RECEIVED, CONDITIONAL_APPROVAL, APPROVED, CLOSING, DOCS.

findings.name: Workflow deduplication on enrollment
findings.finding: WorkflowSLAService.enroll_lead/loan checks for existing active workflow before creating new enrollment.

findings.name: Task generation and assignment
findings.finding: WorkflowTaskGenerator generates tasks for 10 types (phone, text, email, etc.) with role-based assignment and capacity checks (MAX_PENDING_TASKS_PER_USER=50).

findings.name: Mobile dashboard shows workflow tasks
findings.finding: MobileHomeDashboard fetches /api/v1/workflow/tasks and displays pending count, health indicators, and AI eligibility badges.

findings.name: Aria chat reconciles after tool execution
findings.finding: ai_chat_routes.py tracks completed_action_types (sms, task) and calls reconcile_after_action() after successful tool execution.

findings.name: CI artifact execution triggers reconciliation
findings.finding: call_monitoring_routes.py calls _reconcile_ci_artifacts_with_workflows() after artifact execution via ARTIFACT_ACTION_MAP.

findings.name: Sibling task cancellation on contact_made
findings.finding: workflow_reconciliation.py _cancel_sibling_tasks() cancels tasks with same task_group_key when contact is made.

findings.name: 13 event-driven trigger call sites
findings.finding: 8 lead trigger sites (leads_detail_routes x2, webhook_routes, ai_assistant_routes, followupboss_webhook_routes, conversation_intelligence_routes, borrower_application_routes, client_profile_routes) and 5 loan trigger sites (loans_crud_routes, webhook_routes, los_webhook_routes, client_profile_routes, mum_activity_routes).

findings.name: Task instance deduplication
findings.finding: workflow_task_generator.py _create_task_instance() checks for existing active task with same instance_id, day_config_id, task_type before creating.

findings.name: Trigger functions are best-effort (non-blocking)
findings.finding: All 13 trigger call sites wrap in try/except with logger.warning(). Workflow evaluation failure never blocks the stage update response.

findings.name: All 7 SLA transitions have durations
findings.finding: SLA_TARGETS dict defines 7 stage-to-stage transitions with day counts (3/7/2/5/3/3/5).

findings.name: 3-level escalation chain defined
findings.finding: ESCALATION_CHAIN: L1=8 biz hrs (assignee notification), L2=16 biz hrs (manager + reassign), L3=24 biz hrs (branch_manager + flag critical).

findings.name: Business hours calculation
findings.finding: _business_hours_elapsed() counts only Mon-Fri 8AM-6PM (10h/day), properly skips weekends.

findings.name: Admin fallback for NULL manager_id
findings.finding: _find_org_admin_fallback() searches for admin/manager in same organization when manager_id is NULL during escalation.

findings.name: Pipeline alerts use UTC timestamps
findings.finding: pipeline_alerts_routes.py uses datetime.now(timezone.utc).replace(tzinfo=None) for naive UTC consistency with DB columns.

findings.name: Escalation thresholds in business hours
findings.finding: Thresholds (8/16/24) are compared against _business_hours_elapsed(), not calendar hours.

findings.name: useNotifications hook bypasses CSRF-protected api instance
findings.finding: useNotifications.js lines 23-33 use raw fetch() with manual auth headers instead of the shared api axios instance that injects CSRF tokens.
findings.impact: POST/PATCH mutation operations (mark-read, dismiss) lack CSRF protection. Also misses X-Mobile-App header.
findings.recommendation: Refactor to use api.get()/api.post()/api.patch() from services/api.js.

findings.name: All mobile pages use shared api instance
findings.finding: MobileHomeDashboard, MobileLeadsList, MobilePipelineView, MobileAriaChat, MobileCallIntelligence all use api.js or service wrappers (mobileAriaApi, leadsAPI, callMonitoringAPI).

findings.name: Auth protected routes (privateOnly wrapper)
findings.finding: All mobile routes wrapped in privateOnly() which requires PrivateRoute + isAuthenticatedSync().

findings.name: Capacitor navigation allowlist
findings.finding: capacitor.config.ts allowNavigation restricted to perenniaai.com, app.perenniaai.com, api.perenniaai.com, www.perenniaai.com.

findings.name: Response normalization consistency
findings.finding: MobileHomeDashboard uses ad-hoc response normalization (Array.isArray check, data?.loans fallback) while MobileLeadsList has cleaner ensureArray() helper. Inconsistent across pages.
findings.recommendation: Use ensureArray() helper consistently across all mobile pages.

findings.name: Silent zero fallback on dashboard error
findings.finding: MobileHomeDashboard line 382 sets all stats to zero on catch without user indication.
findings.recommendation: Show per-section error states instead of silent zeros.

findings.name: Silent catch on workflow context fetch
findings.finding: MobileAriaChat.jsx lines 399-401 catch workflow task fetch errors with empty catch block. No logging or user indication.

findings.name: Analytics endpoint missing in backend
findings.finding: mobileAnalytics.js line 24 posts to /api/v1/analytics/mobile which has no backend route. Events are silently lost.
findings.recommendation: Create the backend endpoint or disable the flush mechanism.

findings.name: mobileAuditLogger not imported anywhere
findings.finding: mobileAuditLogger.js (445 lines) provides compliance audit logging but is not imported by any mobile page or component.
findings.recommendation: Evaluate compliance requirements and integrate or remove.

findings.name: Mobile tasks endpoint queries tasks table
findings.finding: mobile_tasks_routes.py GET /api/v1/mobile/tasks queries the tasks table (not ai_tasks), with proper status filtering including virtual 'overdue'.

findings.name: Pipeline stages match LoanStage enum
findings.finding: MobilePipelineView PIPELINE_STAGES covers 16 stages including DISCLOSED, UW_RECEIVED, CONDITIONAL_APPROVAL, SUSPENDED, DOCS, NURTURE.

findings.name: Aria chat passes workflow context
findings.finding: MobileAriaChat.jsx fetches pending workflow tasks and passes context to executeTask/sendAriaMessage calls.

findings.name: Call Intelligence uses speechService.js
findings.finding: MobileCallIntelligence.jsx line 591 uses dynamic import of speechService.js (not inline Web Speech API).

findings.name: Mobile dashboard fetches task summary from mobile endpoint
findings.finding: MobileHomeDashboard uses /api/v1/mobile/tasks/summary (not the broken /api/v1/tasks) for task stats.

findings.name: Role-based task assignment with capacity checks
findings.finding: workflow_role_assignment.py provides role-based routing with MAX_PENDING_TASKS_PER_USER=50 capacity limit.

findings.name: Fallback routing (least-loaded user)
findings.finding: resolve_user_for_role() falls back to org default, entity owner, then least-loaded user with the role.

findings.name: MobileBottomNav covers core pages
findings.finding: 5 tabs: Home (/mobile-home), Pipeline (/mobile/pipeline), Aria (/mobile-aria), Contacts (/mobile/leads), More (speed dial).

findings.name: AI confidence threshold for auto-execution
findings.finding: WorkflowAIExecutor auto-executes tasks at 0.95 confidence threshold. Below 0.70 requires manual action.

findings.name: MobileBottomNav has no notification link
findings.finding: Bottom nav has 5 tabs but no direct path to notifications. Users must use the More menu (not yet wired).

findings.name: MobileCallIntelligence is 1,403 lines
findings.finding: Largest mobile component. Could benefit from extraction of speech recognition, artifact management, and timer logic into custom hooks.
findings.recommendation: Consider extracting into useSpeechRecognition, useArtifactPolling, useCallTimer hooks.

findings.name: mobileAnalytics sends events to nonexistent endpoint
findings.finding: Event batching and flush mechanism works but /api/v1/analytics/mobile returns 404. Events silently lost.

findings.name: Mobile-optimized aggregate endpoints exist
findings.finding: mobile_api_routes.py provides /api/v1/mobile/dashboard, /pipeline, /leads, /notifications, /quick-lead, /rate-lock-alerts for reduced round-trips. Good architecture.

sla_config.note: No runtime SLA breach API -- data from static analysis only

task_distribution.note: No runtime task distribution data -- static analysis only

trigger_health.note: All triggers are best-effort, non-blocking, with lazy imports
